use_constraints: Source orthography evidence is not validation of a complete lexical form. Source extent=suff occurs in 357 rows; malformed-looking source strings such as a)pallotri-oia/w (n11312) and diaprakt-prh/ssw (n25630) are preserved literally. Do not silently repair them or promote their normalized keys as independently verified morphology.

Nested dictionary_senses retain containing-source-sense citations and qualifiers. In 277 rows these include qualifiers outside the top-level subentry scope. Consumers must honor qualifier_scope and citation_scope rather than flattening them into subentry or passage claims.
Citations are source-block evidence, not verified passage alignment or evidence that the selected spelling occurs in the cited passage.

This audit verifies all emitted rows, not completeness of extraction across all 116497 LSJ input entries. The existing upstream source audit supplies discovery/license context; this audit rechecked five pinned source downloads.
mutations: Only this audit report was written; no runtime code, source data, staged SQLite, integration or deployment was changed.
